key_insight: The paper builds a comprehensive spin-polarized electronic-structure database for 2,500+ stable halide double perovskites, revealing many candidates with visible-range band gaps and half-metallic behavior.
engineering_relevance: This dataset accelerates materials screening for solar cells and related devices by linking composition to band structure, magnetism, and bonding trends in a single searchable resource.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT calculations of DOS for Cs2BB'X6 compounds
Dataset filtered by Bartel τ-tolerance-factor stability predictions
LOBSTER bonding analysis plus UMAP visualizations and an interactive app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports spin-polarized DOS data for more than 2,500 compounds, including 719 with visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metals.
watch_item: The database is prediction-driven and focused on Cs2BB'X6 compositions, so experimental validation and transferability to broader perovskite families remain important.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
